authorization_basis: User requested completion of the controlled closed-loop/yoked comparison in this chat on 2026-10-24; DATA only, not human scientific review.
disturbance: Even seed: +0.003 Nm; odd seed: -0.003 Nm, ticks [250,500); zero otherwise. Identical schedule in all four challenge arms. Donor and yoked-unperturbed arms receive zero torque.
causal_intervention: Record same-seed unperturbed closed-loop donor first. Freeze its sensor tape before any challenge run. Challenge yoked controller consumes this tape without access to the challenged body's sensors. Closed loop receives current challenged-body sensors. No shifted tape, different targets, learning or condition-specific tuning.
primary_outcome: tracking RMSE over post-step body positions in ticks [250,1000), target +0.25 before tick 500 and -0.25 thereafter
primary_contrast: yoked_challenge minus closed_challenge, paired by seed; positive means closed-loop advantage
analysis: Report every paired difference, mean, median, min, max and positive/zero/negative counts, separately by disturbance sign and pooled. No p-values, no confirmatory threshold, no causal attribution to learned representations.
mandatory_checks: same initial neural/body state and graph within seed
unperturbed yoked trace equals donor trace
challenged yoked observed sensor tape equals frozen donor
challenged yoked motor tape equals donor despite body disturbance
all challenge arms receive identical disturbance schedule
nonzero disturbance changes yoked physical trajectory
failure_rule: Retain partial outputs and failures. No replacement seeds, automatic reruns or post-result tuning. Integrity failure means INVALID, not hypothesis refutation.
claim_boundary: Fixed engineered error receptors and fixed spike-to-torque decoder in a synthetic one-joint world. This tests access to challenge-contingent feedback, not biological equivalence, independent replication, learned body schema, general intelligence or 5D merit. PD arm is attribution reference, not matched neural mechanism.
